title: Authority records
summary: GraphReFly uses one canonical source for each documentation concern.
rules: spec/rules.jsonl is the protocol rule authority.
spec/conformance.jsonl is the behavioral parity authority.
decisions/decisions.jsonl is the architectural decision authority.
plan/phases.jsonl and plan/backlog.jsonl are the sequencer and deferred-work authority.
guide/guide.jsonl is the guide registry; guide families should use guide-local JSONL record sets by default.
dashboard/dashboard.html is generated from authority records and is the internal authority/control view, not a second source.
migration_notes: Legacy prose such as GRAPHREFLY-SPEC.md and COMPOSITION-GUIDE*.md remains migration material until clean content is represented in structured records.

title: Website ownership
summary: graphrefly.dev is the curated external developer docs site, not the full internal authority dashboard.
rules: The shared public website lives in this repo under website/.

Public pages should render user-facing views from selected records: learn/getting-started, core concepts, composition patterns, examples and recipes, package entry points, and curated reference/guarantees.
Internal/maintainer views stay in the generated dashboard and raw repo records.
Full decisions, full protocol rules, conformance coverage, backlog, phases, sessions, gaps, orphans, and project-control state must not become the primary public docs experience.

title: Language package docs delegation
summary: Language package docs remain package-local and are linked, delegated, or embedded only through admitted package routes.
rules: /ts/ delegates to graphrefly-ts for TypeScript API docs, examples, demos, and package release material.
/py/ delegates to graphrefly-py for Python package docs, generated API docs, examples, and package release material.
/rust/ delegates to graphrefly-rs for rustdoc, examples, crate docs, and package release material.
Do not copy generated TypeScript, Python, or Rust API docs into this repo.
Do not hand-maintain mirrors of language package APIs in the shared site.

title: Public build report
summary: The public website build writes generated deploy-inspection metadata, not a new authority source.
rules: website/dist/_meta/public-content-report.json is generated metadata.
The report summarizes rendered public pages, source JSONL, package-owned outbound links, provenance anchors, and no-public-dashboard-link policy.
The report is not a primary public route or source of truth.
Run npm run docs:public:check before publishing public docs changes.

title: JSONL docs default
summary: New shared docs content defaults to JSONL records with stable ids and explicit provenance.
rules: Use guide/guide.jsonl as the registry.

Use guide-local record sets such as guide/learn.jsonl, guide/concepts.jsonl, guide/composition.jsonl, guide/examples.jsonl, guide/testing.jsonl, and guide/contribute.jsonl for content the website renders.
Long-form markdown is migration/reference material unless a future decision explicitly makes it canonical for a concern.
Records should include stable ids, audience/publicness metadata, summaries, body fields, source refs, and links to governing rules, decisions, conformance scenarios, or examples when applicable.

title: Public guide record shape
summary: Primary public guide pages render only active public records and use provenance refs compactly.

shape.refs_policy: refs are provenance and may be shown as compact source anchors; public pages must not render raw decision, rule, conformance, backlog, session, or dashboard text as main content
shape.package_refs_policy: package_refs may link to language-local docs or runnable examples but must not copy generated API references, package release material, or demo bodies into this repo

title: Public reference records
summary: guide/reference.jsonl is the curated public guarantee layer for /reference, not a public dashboard or API mirror.
rules: Reference records use area=reference, kind=guarantee, and route=/reference.
audience includes developer; publicness is public; status is active.
owner and canonical_repo are graphrefly.
render_policy.primary is true, render_policy.render_refs is provenance-only, and render_policy.api_docs is delegate.
package_refs delegate only to /ts/, /py/, and /rust/.
Public prose should lead with developer outcomes.

title: Public package entry records
summary: guide/packages.jsonl is the shared site package directory for /packages, /ts, /py, and /rust.
rules: Package entry records use area=packages, kind=package-entry, and package=ts, py, or rust.
route is the matching public package route: /ts, /py, or /rust.
canonical_repo is the language package repo.
entry_links point to package-owned docs/repo surfaces and may be shown as outbound links, not copied into the shared site.
refs.decisions cites D32 and D563.
render_policy.api_docs and render_policy.package_docs are both delegate.
Public prose should describe ownership and next-step links only. Do not include code snippets, generated API bodies, symbol tables, demos, release notes, or package-local examples.

title: Migration rules
summary: Only clean authority content should move into the shared site.
rules: Re-home only clean authority content into the shared site.
Use old graphrefly-ts/website assets and components as visual or tooling reference only.
Reject stale pre-clean-slate content, retired root-package material, structural parity narratives, old port-ledger material, and package-specific API pages.
Any future change that makes the shared site authoritative for package APIs, package demos, generated references, package releases, or deploy ownership needs a new decision before implementation.
